description: Test suite for delivery context helper functions in a messaging SDK, verifying normalization, merging, key generation, conversation formatting, delivery target resolution, and session delivery field normalization.

methods.name: setActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Sets the active plugin registry for testing purposes.

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base plugin object for channel testing with specified ID and label.

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a test plugin registry with specified plugins.

methods.name: normalizeDeliveryContext
methods.description: Normalizes delivery context fields by trimming and removing empty values.

methods.name: mergeDeliveryContext
methods.description: Merges two delivery contexts considering channel and route fields to inherit missing information appropriately.

methods.name: deliveryContextFromSession
methods.description: Derives a delivery context from session data, normalizing fields and inheriting values.

methods.name: deliveryContextKey
methods.description: Builds a stable key string for a delivery context based on channel, to, and optionally accountId and threadId.

methods.name: formatConversationTarget
methods.description: Formats a conversation target, supporting generic channels and plugin-defined targets.

methods.name: resolveConversationDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Resolves the delivery target for plugin-defined conversation IDs, especially child threads.

methods.name: normalizeSessionDeliveryFields
methods.description: Normalizes delivery fields from session data, avoiding cross-channel carryover and trimming values.
